description: List org-level AI provider connections with optional workspace or type filters. Use this to find integration slugs before model or workspace updates. Returns total plus id, name, slug, provider, status, description, workspace counts, and config summary.

current_page.description: Zero-based page number; the first page is 0

page_size.description: Number of results per page (default 100, max 100)

workspace_id.description: Filter integrations accessible by a specific workspace

name: list_integrations

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
